pending_interview.category: System design (ML/AI-specific) — RAG at scale, eval pipeline design, recommendation systems, agent platforms, feature store design
pending_interview.question: You are designing a feature store for a large e-commerce platform. The platform has hundreds of ML models in production — covering recommendations, fraud detection, pricing, and search ranking — all needing access to features (pre-computed input signals like "user's average order value in last 30 days"). Walk me through how you would design this feature store: how features are computed and stored, how you handle the difference between features needed at training time versus features needed at inference time (i.e., when a model is making a live prediction), how you ensure consistency between those two, and how you would handle a feature that needs to be updated in near-real-time (like "number of failed login attempts in the last 5 minutes").
